newsitem.title: POLAND: Agros to buy two food firms in Q2 or Q3.
newsitem.headline: Agros to buy two food firms in Q2 or Q3.

text.p: Polish food producer and trader Agros Holding SA expects to buy from the state treasury a farm and a grain mill firm at the end of the second or in the third quarter, the president of the firm said on Tuesday.
Zofia Gaber told a news briefing Agros was planning several other purchases of food processing firms, but did not give details.

"What seems closest now is a farm in Poznanskie, we are also thinking about a grain mill firm...negotiations (on the purchases) are advanced, we would like to finalize them in this half of the year," she said .
"I think the third quarter would be the latest," she said.
